summary: Multiple HIGH severity CVEs (CVE-2023-6129, CVE-2024-21000, CVE-2026-21936, CVE-2026-22015) have been identified in MySQL 8.0.43-1.el9_6 dependencies within the temporalio/admin-tools:1.27.2 Docker image. This is a vendor-dependent base image issue requiring upstream resolution.
userImpact: Users running the temporalio/admin-tools:1.27.2 Docker image are exposed to multiple HIGH severity security vulnerabilities in MySQL dependencies.
rootCause: MySQL version 8.0.43-1.el9_6 in the vendor-dependent base image contains multiple known CVEs.
keyQuote: This is a vendor-dependent base image issue that requires upstream resolution from the Temporal project.
